title: Implement a Sparse Mixture of Experts Layer
prompt: Implement a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layer using softmax gating and top-k routing. Given an input tensor, a set of expert weight matrices, a gating weight matrix, and parameters specifying the number of experts and the value of k, compute the final MoE output by selecting the top-k experts per token, applying their transformations, and aggregating the results weighted by the normalized gating probabilities.
